name: Browser Login
description: Log in with a login the user saved in this workspace's browser vault, without ever seeing the password: the browser fills it into the fields you name, on the login's own site only. action list shows the saved logins (id, site, username) and which fit this chat's page; login fills one into the username field (user_ref) and/or the password field (pass_ref) from the last read, and submit presses Enter; code fills the current 2FA code into the code field (ref). Some logins ask the user first: this waits for their OK in the browser view. If there's no saved login for the site, ask (on its sign-in page) gives you a card for your reply where the user saves one for this page's site; for a CAPTCHA, SSO or a payment hand the browser to them with browser-handoff. Never ask the user for a password in the chat.
author: anything

examples.prompt: (on GitHub's sign-in page, and the list has no login for github.com)

action.description: list the saved logins, ask the user for one for this page's site (ask), fill one in (login), or fill its 2FA code (code).

login.description: The saved login's id, from list.

user_ref.description: login: the ref of the username or email field (e12), if the page has one.

pass_ref.description: login: the ref of the password field, if the page has one.

ref.description: code: the ref of the 2FA code field.

submit.description: Press Enter in the last field filled, to send the form.
